verdict.rationale: The only story-relevant control is branch-level: repository rulesets protect matching branches or tags by requiring pull requests, reviews (including CODEOWNERS approval) and passing checks, or by blocking deletion and force pushes. These are protection rules rather than per-user permission assignment, and nothing shows role or permission assignment at the organization, project, repository or environment level. missing for 10: organization-level roles/permissions, project-level permissions, repository-level collaborator/team access roles, environment-level permissions or protections, explicit per-user/team permission assignment on branches, independent corroboration
